title: Intercropping generates trait plasticity, which corresponds with year‐to‐year stability in productivity
content:
Our study provides evidence of the greater productivity and temporal stability of species-diverse intercropping systems. Interspecific interaction-induced plasticity suggests a unique mechanism for biodiversity effects on ecosystem function, which adds to our understanding of fixed, or inherent, variation in traits among genotypes or species. Theoretically, our findings provide novel insights into how interspecific interactions contribute to ecosystem service, especially in yield temporal stability, by increased trait plasticity of the dominant crop, maize. The results also had implications for applying intercropping in the sustainable management of food-production systems with the use of more crop species. Greater stability in production has the potential to provide a stable income for farmers.


Abstract

Environmentally friendly approaches to increasing food production include using the positive effects of plant biodiversity, such as in intercropping. Functional traits are key drivers of these positive effects, in part because variation in functional traits can increase niche partitioning. However, we know little about how variation in functional traits affects the long-term stability of yield in agroecosystems. We conducted a 5-year field experiment with five different cropping systems; maize/peanut, maize/soybean intercropping, and maize, peanut and soybean monocultures. We compared the productivity of monocultures to intercrops and then compared plasticity in functional traits at different rates of nitrogen supply between the cropping systems. Intercropping generated plasticity, measured here as the inverse of the coefficient of variation, in three functional traits of maize (height, stem diameter and ear height), which probably increases above-ground spatial niche differentiation, and decreases the intraspecific competition of maize. Intercropping also increased the stability of grain yield and above-ground biomass. Plasticity in functional traits of maize correlated positively with year-to-year temporal stability (CV−1) of grain yield and biomass of maize and with the total productivity of the agroecosystem. Synthesis and applications. Our study provides evidence of the greater productivity and temporal stability of species-diverse intercropping systems. Interspecific interaction-induced plasticity suggests a unique mechanism for biodiversity effects on ecosystem function, which adds to our understanding of fixed, or inherent, variation in traits among genotypes or species. Theoretically, our findings provide novel insights into how interspecific interactions contribute to ecosystem service, especially in yield temporal stability, by increased trait plasticity of the dominant crop, maize. The results also had implications for applying intercropping in the sustainable management of food-production systems with the use of more crop species. Greater stability in production has the potential to provide a stable income for farmers.

摘要

生物多样性能够强化生态系统服务功能，如增加生态系统的生产力，提高资源利用效率，增强生态系统的稳定性。植物功能性状不仅能够响应种间或种内相互作用，也能够预测植物间相互作用的变化，并解释生态系统功能提高的机制，在多样化种植强化生态系统功能的过程中发挥了重要作用。然而，对于功能性状的变化如何影响农田生态系统中的生产力时间稳定性还有待进一步研究。 本研究设置了一个两因素裂区设计的田间试验，主因素为4个施氮水平(N0，N1，N2，N3)，副因素为5种种植模式(玉米/花生间作、玉米/大豆间作、玉米、花生和大豆单作)，共3个重复。产量稳定性和间作效应基于5年(2017–2021)的结果进行分析。作物功能性状在作物的收获期进行采样测定，通过计算作物功能性状的变异系数来衡量植物功能性状在单间作中的变化。 通过对五年的结果进行分析，不同的间作模式相比于对应的单作均具有显著的产量优势，同时也提高了土地当量比，强化了土地利用效率。玉米单作、玉米/大豆、玉米/花生间作体系的生产力时间稳定性均随着施氮量的增加而增加；在相同的施氮条件下，间作体系的生产力时间稳定性均高于对应单作。间作增加了生长性状的种内变异而降低了生殖性状的种内变异，生长性状种内变异的增加意味着种内生态位的分化，可能会降低种内竞争，而生殖性状(穗粗)变异的降低是间作体系稳定性增加的主要原因。 综合与应用: 我们的研究证明了间作体系具有更高的生产力时间稳定性。种间相互作用驱动的功能性状可塑性解释了稳定性提高的机制。通过调控高产作物玉米的功能性状可塑性可以强化间作体系的生态服务功能，尤其是产量的时间稳定性。
